words.s: 生活太紧张了也不好，要多做运动来减压。
words.t: Life being too tense isn't good; exercise more to relieve stress.

words.s: 他对户外活动非常感兴趣。
words.t: He's very interested in outdoor activities.

words.s: 这个活动非常惊险，你要小心。
words.t: This activity is thrilling and dangerous; be careful.

words.s: 很多年轻人都喜欢刺激的活动。
words.t: Many young people like exciting activities.

words.s: 在我的生命中，家人是最重要的。
words.t: In my life, family is the most important thing.

words.s: 我们吃东西时要有节制。
words.t: We should eat in moderation.

words.s: 这个小说的内容很有意思。
words.t: This novel's content is very interesting.

words.s: 电子游戏里有很多暴力的内容。
words.t: Video games contain a lot of violent content.

words.s: 这个电影有黄色的内容，不适合小孩观看。
words.t: This film has adult content and isn't suitable for children.

words.s: 我明天要和朋友去观看足球比赛。
words.t: Tomorrow I'm going to watch a football match with friends.

words.s: 自从在网上认识了新朋友，她每个晚上都和朋友聊到很晚。
words.t: Since making a new friend online, she chats with them late every night.

words.s: 他的人际关系很差，没有什么朋友。
words.t: His social relationships are poor; he has few friends.

words.s: 妈妈要我减少看电视的时间。
words.t: Mum wants me to watch less TV.

words.s: 我希望有个机器人帮我做作业。
words.t: I wish I had a robot to do my homework.

words.s: 这个电子游戏很受中学生喜爱。
words.t: This video game is very popular with secondary school students.

words.s: 我的老师很严肃。
words.t: My teacher is very serious.

words.s: 她晚上一个人走路回家，感到很害怕。
words.t: She felt scared walking home alone at night.

words.s: 我的中文老师经常批评我。
words.t: My Chinese teacher often criticises me.

words.s: 她的声音很优美。
words.t: Her voice is beautiful.

words.s: 这首歌很好听，大家都很喜欢。
words.t: This song sounds great; everyone likes it.

words.s: 明天有英文课吗？
words.t: Is there an English lesson tomorrow?

words.s: 这些单词我都不会，该怎么办？
words.t: I don't know any of these words; what should I do?

words.s: 这个课文很短、很容易。
words.t: This text is short and easy.

words.s: 老师不喜欢我们在上课时讲话。
words.t: The teacher doesn't like us talking in class.

words.s: 老师每天批改我们的作业。
words.t: The teacher marks our homework every day.

words.s: 我的妈妈是家庭主妇，每天都很忙。
words.t: My mum is a housewife and is busy every day.

words.s: 我们要从错误中学习。
words.t: We should learn from our mistakes.

words.s: 我生病了，妈妈明天要请假一天照顾我。
words.t: I'm ill, so Mum will take a day off tomorrow to look after me.

words.s: 爸爸今天回来很高兴，因为他涨工资了。
words.t: Dad came home happy today because he got a pay rise.

words.s: 青春应该怎样度过？
words.t: How should one spend one's youth?

words.s: 中式教育和西式教育非常不同。
words.t: Chinese-style and Western-style education are very different.

words.s: 娱乐可以调剂紧张的生活。
words.t: Entertainment can balance out a stressful life.

words.s: 你不可能同时出现在两个地方。
words.t: You can't be in two places at once.

words.s: 家庭教育对于学生的成长，有着不可替代的作用。
words.t: Family education plays an irreplaceable role in a student's growth.

words.s: 那位演员的真人比在电影里还漂亮。
words.t: That actor is even better-looking in person than in films.

words.s: 现在手机应用软件很多，要小心选择。
words.t: There are so many phone apps now; choose carefully.

words.s: 妈妈每天都看天气预报。
words.t: Mum checks the weather forecast every day.

words.s: 不要随地乱丢东西。
words.t: Don't litter everywhere.

words.s: 明天的气温多少？
words.t: What's the temperature tomorrow?

words.s: 下雨了，可是我没有带雨伞，怎么办？
words.t: It's raining but I didn't bring an umbrella; what shall I do?

words.s: 我喜欢用日记来记录自己的生活。
words.t: I like keeping a diary to record my life.

words.s: 现在的情况不同了。
words.t: The situation is different now.

words.s: 他喜欢极限运动，例如爬山、跳伞、冲浪等。
words.t: He likes extreme sports, such as climbing, skydiving and surfing.

words.s: 这些数据对我们非常有用。
words.t: This data is very useful to us.

words.s: 我今天上传了好几个好玩的视频。
words.t: I uploaded several fun videos today.

words.s: 我的朋友圈里有很多朋友。
words.t: I have lots of friends in my social circle.

words.s: 他喜欢蓝色、绿色以及黑色。
words.t: He likes blue, green and black.

words.s: 我在兄弟姐妹中排第一。
words.t: I'm the eldest among my siblings.

words.s: 学习数学是一件很枯燥的事。
words.t: Studying maths is very dull.

words.s: 我和家人喜欢在饭后出去散步。
words.t: My family and I like going for a walk after meals.

words.s: 他上个月生了一场大病，因此瘦了不少。
words.t: He was seriously ill last month, so he lost a lot of weight.

words.s: 我讨厌别人在我面前抽烟。
words.t: I hate people smoking in front of me.

words.s: 你知道这个字的笔顺吗？
words.t: Do you know the stroke order of this character?

words.s: 这个字的笔画很多。
words.t: This character has many strokes.

words.s: 你可以上网查询明天的天气。
words.t: You can check tomorrow's weather online.

words.s: 这个字笔画很多，你跟着老师慢慢写。
words.t: This character has many strokes; follow the teacher and write it slowly.
